start the file-edit clock during review and risk premature opening if
acceptance slips past the date. A reserved DOI is citable in the manuscript

both assays, so matched RNA and protein for a tissue arrive together.

the 50 GB cap, and a normal/PDAC split does not rescue it (normal alone is
58.5 GB), so pancreas is split by platform.
Archives are split across two machines: CosMx on Cayuga, Xenium locally.
Both halves upload to the same draft from where they already sit.

_naming: Directory slugs carry v1 so a v2 tree can be built alongside without collisions.
Zenodo never sees the slug -- record identity is the title plus the DOI.
Versioning is Zenodo-native: v2 is published as a new version of the same
record, sharing one concept DOI that always resolves to the latest. The
version lives in the `version` field and the title suffix, not in the record
name, so the concept DOI stays citable across versions.
